# Loomio

Loomio is a collaborative decision-making platform that enables groups to discuss, propose, and make decisions together.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/loomio/.

## Actions

- **List Groups** (read-only): List all groups accessible to the user.
- **List Polls** (read-only): List all polls accessible to the user.
- **Show Group** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific group.
- **SHOW_POLL** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific poll.
